answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The island holds work receipts rather than names, so the saffron of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the copper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
